vectors.name: contract

owner_words.text: I need a clamp for integer arrays that never allocates.

restatement.objective: A kernel that clamps every element of an i32 array into [lo, hi] in place.
assumptions: lo <= hi is the caller’s job

questions_asked.q: In place, or a new array?

acceptance.says: Values below lo become lo and above hi become hi.
acceptance.author: sage

acceptance.says: Every output is between lo and hi.
acceptance.author: sage

check.predicate: lo > hi || out.every(v => lo <= v && v <= hi)

acceptance.says: The delivered package runs its own self-check.
acceptance.author: sage
